threatModel.summary: Wraith Protocol implements stealth address cryptography (ERC-5564/ERC-6538) for unlinkable payments. Our threat model assumes adversaries can observe all blockchain data and network traffic but cannot break discrete log assumptions or compromise user key material stored in secure enclaves.
assumptions: Blockchain data is fully public and observable
Network traffic between client and infrastructure may be monitored
Attacker cannot break ECDSA or ECDH assumptions
User wallets and hardware devices are trusted security boundaries
outOfScope: Physical device theft without proper key protection
Denial of service attacks on public infrastructure

disclosure.timeline: 90 days from report to public disclosure
scope: This marketing website (XSS, CSRF, data leaks)

keyManagement.signingInfra: Release signing keys are stored in hardware security modules (HSMs) and rotated quarterly. Package signatures use Sigstore for transparency.
keyManagement.developerKeys: Development team PGP keys are published at https://usewraith.xyz/.well-known/openpgpkey and cross-signed.
keyManagement.rotation: Key rotation policy: 90 days for development keys, 180 days for release signing keys, immediate rotation on suspected compromise.

dependencies.policy: All dependencies are pinned to specific versions in package-lock.json. Automated Dependabot alerts are enabled for critical vulnerabilities.
dependencies.review: Dependency updates are reviewed monthly, with security patches applied within 48 hours of disclosure.
dependencies.supply: We use npm audit and Snyk for continuous dependency scanning.

audits.scope: Core SDK cryptographic implementation (ERC-5564 stealth address derivation and scanning)

bounty.eligibility: Vulnerabilities in @wraith-protocol/sdk, stealth address implementation, or key infrastructure components.
bounty.ineligibility: Issues already known, out-of-scope systems, or non-security bugs.

compliance.frameworks: Our security posture is informed by NIST Cybersecurity Framework and Web3 security best practices.
